question: Does source-blind coordinated one/two-coefficient GF(2) weight repair escape WSP147 single-coordinate training local minima AND improve unseen post-action causal predictions on a fresh nested-composition family under matched actions, evidence and strong independent fully fitted controls?

hypotheses.H1_training: Multi-coordinate strict-error-reducing edits yield at least 8 additional exact 32-observation training fits among 32 primary NESTED worlds versus a 24-coefficient-write single-coordinate capacity-matched ablation.
hypotheses.H2_generalization: On 256 shared post-seal unseen NESTED questions, block edits yield at least +3 percentage points correct versus the strongest of identical-information fully fitted CART, independent full 64-term polynomial solution, and capacity-matched single edits, without >1% confident error or hidden-query/label access.
hypotheses.no_claim: H1 training success alone is not causal transfer or H2 scientific success. All native model and independent scientific claims require separately qualified trials.

candidate.foundation: 64 binary numerical coefficients over the six-bit GF(2) monomial crossbar, initial vector zero. This is a source-blind numerical weight-edit rule, not a token architecture or supplied MAJ/MUX/threshold oracle.
candidate.observation_input: 32 typed (x, actual_effect) pairs from own acquisition arm only; no source module, family IDs, hidden labels, post-seal query coordinates or other arm observations.
candidate.rule: At each step enumerate all 64 distinct one-bit toggles and 2016 unordered two-bit toggles; compute exact Hamming-error reduction on own 32 observed outcomes by XORing affected feature signatures. Commit the best strictly improving block under frozen tie-break: greatest reduction, fewest flips, smallest resulting active coefficient count, smallest sum of feature degrees, lexicographic indices. Never accept a zero-gain move. Maximum 24 total coefficient flips across all blocks; when no admissible strict gain, stop. Allow toggling coefficients off. No gradients, source truth, grammar-specific library, or post-result parameter changes.
candidate.admission: Only produce confident 64-input predictions if all 32 observed effects fit exactly; otherwise 64 abstentions. This exact-fit gate is frozen and may cause scientific failure.
candidate.budget: At most 24 individual bit toggles across up to 24 chosen steps. All 64 coefficients remain representable, including constant; no 16-bit capacity truncation.
candidate.cold: Persist numerical coefficient bits, sequence of edited indices and charged-row hash; reconstruct and verify identical 64 predictions from own prior observations with zero new source calls.

ablations_and_controls.single24: Same numerical basis, tie-breaking and 24 total coefficient flips, but exactly one coordinate per step. Identical charged rows and max write budget; isolates coordination.
ablations_and_controls.parent_single16: Unchanged WSP147 direct.py 16 strict single-coordinate edits on identical rows.
ablations_and_controls.full_poly_symbolic: Independent WSP147 full 64-feature GF2 row reduction, trained on all 32 observed outcomes; rank and full prediction equality checked.
ablations_and_controls.conventional_CART: Unchanged WSP135 fully fitted CART trained on all 32 observed outcomes.
ablations_and_controls.hierarchical_and_symbolic: Unchanged WSP143 hierarchical 4-term learner, independent equal-prior symbolic must tie on every generated prediction.
ablations_and_controls.original_latent_and_direct3: Unchanged WSP135 latent learner and WSP142 3-term direct numerical baseline.
ablations_and_controls.no_update: All-abstain baseline; negative control OFF random truth family.
ablations_and_controls.fair_information: Every comparator must receive the SAME own-arm 32 charged observations and same postseal hidden questions as block candidate.

source.kind: Fresh PUBLIC SYNTHETIC only, not original CausalGym, DTR, MDP or protected native first-use.

seeds.known: 300000..300007 (8; permuted two-input AND XOR singleton XOR seed parity)
seeds.three: 301000..301007 (8; permuted triple AND XOR pair AND XOR singleton XOR seed parity)
seeds.nested: 302000..302031 (32 primary; permuted y= (b0&b1) XOR (b2|b3) if b4 else ((b1 XOR b2)&b5), XOR seed parity)
seeds.cross: 303000..303007 (8; permuted five-input threshold >=4 XOR (sixth bit AND first bit) XOR seed parity)
seeds.off: 304000..304007 (8; seeded independent Bernoulli output per x)

source.generation: Separate sha256 source namespace + seed and deterministic public six-input permutation per new law, source-private truth table owned by evaluator. Candidate code is prohibited from accessing this generation logic.
forbidden: All WSP135–147 previously scored public and reserved seeds
source.admission: No charged effects may be opened until source-free negative and functional qualification PASS. Protect the experiment with a single-use seed/receipt ledger. Original source first-use remains DENIED.

acquisition.per_world: All three share 20 warm actions; each acquires 12 more own-action consequences without looking at future questions. Exactly 32 per world/arm.
acquisition.held: After owner receives complete 64-prediction vectors for all arms/models, select 8 shared never-paid x from three-arm action union complement using SHA256('WSP148|HELD|public_law_id|x'). Labels remain private, always score on the same held x.
acquisition.statistics: 32 independent NESTED worlds are independent resampling units; within-world 8 questions are correlated. Report per-world paired gain, fixed-seed 95% world-bootstrap interval and per-world exact-fit comparisons.
acquisition.no_cross_world_claim: Worlds are fit independently; no transfer of learned weights between worlds. Cold restore demonstrates identity, not cross-world knowledge learning.

frozen_decision.efficiency: Measure whole-process wall and CPU for candidate vs controls, peak memory and per-arm action counts. No acceleration claim without cost-matched benefit and end-to-end time. A faster failed learner is not an improvement.
frozen_decision.invalid: INVALID_PROTOCOL if source custody, hidden queries, parental SHA/first-use, exact source or matched controls are violated. Mechanical CI failure is not scientific negative.

qualification.phase1: Commit this prereg.json as sole changed file at qualified WSP147 parent SHA before implementation, source, tests or observations.
qualification.phase2: Implement one source-blind candidate + single24 ablation and fabricated-row source-free negative controls, qualify Linux/Windows with ZERO actual source effect calls.
qualification.phase3: Implement independent frozen new public source and owner-only evaluator, run authentic first source-effect study once on protected namespace and archive result even if NO-GO. Never retroactively call replay virgin first-use.
qualification.phase4: Source-pin G29 derived-only three atlas outputs and run full inherited WSP135–148 + complete root regression on both operating systems against final exact tree; separate independent G29 qualification.
qualification.boundaries: Draft isolated contributor research only; no merge, accepted main edit, source first-use on original datasets, native weight changes, controller/runner/scheduler, paid APIs, deployment, or promotion.
